title: ComparePanes
responsibility: Renders paired revision content with side-bound headings, roles, gaps and metadata slots.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.panes
inputs.description: An array of side contexts to render. Entries are filtered by visible and keyed by key; shown panes provide heading and role, while value and optional gap select the content path.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.visible
inputs.description: Selects both sides or only entries whose side matches before or after; the default is both. Filtering does not rewrite a pane's heading or role.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.className
inputs.description: Sets the class on the outer wrapper. Defaults to ex-panes.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.paneClass
inputs.description: Sets the class on each pane frame when framed is true; it has no effect when frames are disabled. Defaults to ex-pane.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.framed
inputs.description: When true (the default), wraps each shown pane in a group and enables its heading, gap, children and details branches. When false, renders only the children slot for each shown pane.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.headings
inputs.description: When true (the default) inside framed panes, renders the provided heading slot or the pane heading and role. When false, omits that heading.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.contents
inputs.description: When true, sets inline display: contents on the outer wrapper so an existing parent can arrange the pane boxes. When false, omits that inline style.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.gap
inputs.description: Optional slot receiving a pane when the framed rendering branch has value === undefined and a truthy gap; it is not used otherwise. Without this slot, that branch renders EmptyState with the pane's gap.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.children
inputs.description: Required slot receiving each shown pane. In framed mode it is skipped only when value === undefined and gap is truthy; without frames it renders for every shown pane.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.heading
inputs.description: Optional slot receiving the pane when headings and framed are true. It replaces the default pane heading and role, and is not rendered when headings are disabled or frames are off.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.details
inputs.description: Optional slot receiving the same pane after its content. It renders only in framed mode, and defaults to omitted.

outputs.name: ComparePanes
outputs.description: Produces an outer hx-div containing the shown panes. A pane frame is present only when framed is true, and the outer element gets paired only when more than one pane remains after filtering.

errors.name: Content slot error
errors.description: The component does not catch render errors from an invoked children, heading, details, or gap slot; those errors propagate. Slots skipped by the visibility, framing, heading, or gap branches are not invoked.
